#include <iostream>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

ll modpow(ll a, ll b, ll mod) {
    ll res = 1;
    a %= mod;
    while (b) {
        if (b & 1) res = (res * a) % mod;
        a = (a * a) % mod;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ll n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;
    ll d = r - l + 1;
    ll a = d / 2;
    ll b = d - a;
    ll nm = n * m;
    const ll mod = 998244353;
    ll ans = (modpow(a + b, nm, mod) + modpow((a > b) ? (a - b) : (b - a), nm, mod)) % mod;
    ans = (ans * modpow(2, mod - 2, mod)) % mod;
    if (nm % 2 == 1) {
        ans = modpow(d, nm, mod);
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
